docs.title: 欢迎来到我的个人主页
我是谁？
docs.text:
如你所见, 我只是一个做这个网站的普通人, 任何对自己的直接介绍都不可避免地沦为标签化的扁平描述, 而我没有"认识自己"的智慧. 所以, 如果对我感兴趣, 你可以自行打开这些目录浏览, 那时你就会对我形成一套独特的印象了.

页面下方是我的GitHub主页和BiliBili主页. 我的常用邮箱是ziruili6039@qq.com. 我很欢迎你带着话题来聊天, 也乐于解答你的问题. 另外如果你对我足够熟悉, 你也许能在知乎上找到我的账号, 这里我就保留一些神秘感吧.

docs.title: 研究速览
docs.text:
我是上海交通大学 Wilczek 量子中心 (WQC) 的理论物理直博生。当前主要研究方向为非晶固体中的几何与拓扑缺陷，融合统计物理、凝聚态理论和数值模拟方法。

其他活跃兴趣包括非平衡量子多体动力学、无序系统中的经典随机热力学、以及量子热化（MBL、ETH、Floquet 系统、时间晶体）。

docs.title: 我为什么要做这个网站
docs.text: 我最初只是为了把我本科期间的物理学习(特别是在北航物理评论特刊中我的讲稿)记录下来, 并把我整理的资料分享给其他人. 不过有了我自己的网站, 多写点其他的似乎也不错? 于是就有了如此多的条目.

docs.title: Who Am I?
docs.text:
As you can see, I'm just an ordinary person maintaining this website. Any direct self-introduction inevitably reduces a person to a flattened set of labels, and I lack the wisdom to "know myself."

So if you're interested, feel free to browse the directories above — by doing so, you'll form your own unique impression of me.

Below you'll find my GitHub and BiliBili. My email is ziruili6039@qq.com. I welcome you to reach out for discussions, and I'm happy to answer your questions.

docs.title: Research Snapshot
docs.text:
I am a theoretical physics Ph.D. student at the Wilczek Quantum Center (WQC), Shanghai Jiao Tong University. My current main research focuses on geometry and topological defects in amorphous solids, combining ideas from statistical physics, condensed matter theory, and numerical simulation.

Other active interests include non-equilibrium quantum many-body dynamics, classical stochastic thermodynamics in disordered systems, and quantum thermalization (MBL, ETH, Floquet systems, time crystals).

docs.title: Why This Website?
docs.text:
I initially built this site to document my undergraduate physics studies (especially my talks for the Beihang Physics Review Special Issue) and share the materials I've compiled with others.

But with my own website, why not add a few more things? And so here we are.
